in breathing air systems and an undisputed leading position in industrial applications, supported by a global service network.
What
is the I26 series used for?
The I26 series comprises water-cooled high-pressure compressors for the compression of air and nitrogen. It is used whenever these gases need to be reliably compressed from atmospheric pressure to high final pressures and supplied over long periods in continuous operation. Typical applications include industrial compressed air and nitrogen supply, process gas systems, research and development, test facilities and applications with permanent high-pressure demand where thermal stability and high operational reliability are required.
What
performance ranges does the I26 series cover?
The I26 high-pressure compressors achieve final pressures from 90 to 420 bar. The effective delivery rates range from approximately 2,200 to 3,300 litres per minute, depending on configuration, inlet pressure and operating conditions. This makes the series suitable for medium to high-capacity industrial applications in continuous operation.

characterises the technical concept of the I26 series?

B-SELECT
Automatic selector unit

For simultaneous filling of pressure cylinders with air from
storage system and compressor
Inlet pressure up to 420 bar
Flow rate up to 850 bar

The automatic selector unit enables compressed air cylinders to be filled quickly and simultaneously in parallel from
a single storage system (buffer) and via one compressor.
Important! The automatic selector unit works most effectively when the nominal pressure in the storage system
and the breathing air cylinder are nearly the same.

HOW IT WORKS
Filling of the breathing air cylinder connected to the filling panel takes priority. This means that the storage system
and the compressor always fill the cylinder connected to the filling panel first. Once the cylinders are completely
filled, the automatic selector unit independently switches over to filling the storage system.

When the maximum filling pressure of the storage system is reached, the compressor shuts down fully
automatically. As soon as the next empty breathing air cylinder is connected to the filling panel, the storage system
again fills the breathing air cylinder first. If the preset restart pressure in the storage system is undershot, the
compressor switches on.

The compressor then fills the breathing air cylinder up to the value preset on the backpressure regulator / pressure

results.title: PE-VE series · Air-cooled compressors | BAUER KOMPRESSOREN
results.content:
Document: PE-VE series · Air-cooled compressors | BAUER KOMPRESSOREN
r?
Depending on the version, PE-VE compressors cover pressure ranges from 90 to 365 bar. Certain models are also available for final pressures of up to 420 bar.
What delivery rates are possible with PE-VE compressors?
PE-VE compressors achieve delivery rates of approximately 85 to 800 l/min. The actual delivery rate depends on the model and the specific configuration.
Which gases are PE-VE compressors suitable for?
PE-VE compressors are designed for the compression of air, nitrogen, and forming gas. They are intended for reliable continuous operation in industrial environments.
What technically distinguishes PE-VE compressors?
The systems are based on proven BAUER high-pressure blocks and are designed for robustness, long service life, and continuous industrial duty. The design focuses on reliable technology and an especially attractive price-performance ratio.
How are PE-VE compressors controlled and monitored?
The compressor is equipped with the B-CONTROL MICRO control system. It enables easy operation, safe monitoring of operating parameters, and connectivity to the B-CLOUD and B-APP.
What
are the benefits of B-CLOUD?
B-CLOUD enables centralized digital monitoring of the compressor. Operators have continuous access to operating data, can monitor system status, and plan maintenance more efficiently.
How maintenance-friendly are PE-VE compressors?

results.content:
Document: PE-VE (420 bar) · POSEIDON EDITION | BAUER KOMPRESSOREN
n of the B-CONTROL MICRO with the B-CLOUD. They establish a reliable Wi-Fi or mobile network connection, allowing secure remote access to the compressor system.
Integrated gas measurement system B-DETECTION PLUS i
The integrated B-DETECTION PLUS gas measurement system monitors breathing air and Nitrox in real time according to DIN EN 12021:2014. It measures CO, CO₂, O₂, humidity, and VOCs, and protects with automatic shutdown in case of limit exceedance. The CO ping test checks sensors before start. With B-CLOUD, digital documentation and remote access are possible. Optionally, contaminated air can be vented automatically outdoors.
Base frame
On the extended base frame, the compressor and up to two storage cylinders, each with a geometric volume of 50 or 80 liters, are mounted to form a turnkey system. This compact solution simplifies both installation and operation.
Monitoring of intermediate pressures and intermediate stage temperatures
This monitoring system is ideal for continuous or fully automatic operation, as well as for systems without constant specialist supervision. If defined limit values are exceeded or undershot, an automatic shutdown is triggered. The current actual values are displayed in the B-CONTROL compressor control system.
Exhaust shaft
